individual_findings: Individually reviewed all 74 controls and three actual presets across eight logo/quote/source/badge/link slots. Removed fabricated publications, quotes, awards and certifications from new defaults/presets while saved configured claims render unchanged. Captured complete item wrappers prevent conditional link boundary ambiguity. Image-only, quote-only, source-only and badge-only links all have meaningful native/merchant names; URLs and plain copy are escaped. Native image alt follows explicit metadata/source fallback; source-only cards no longer repeat the same attribution. Empty storefront output hides with editor guidance. Bounded nested columns/padding, focus, native wrapper and progressive/editor motion preserved.

individual_findings: Individually reviewed all 83 controls and three presets across eight icon/image/heading/richtext/action slots. New presets become neutral grid/inline/card layouts without invented shipping, payment verification, privacy or guarantee claims; saved merchant messaging remains intact. Plain icon text is escaped, native images have useful alt fallback and use image_size independently of icon_size so oversized badge art is not clipped into an icon circle. Complete action-only badges render; incomplete actions and blank content wrappers omit. Bounded padding/width, wrapped narrow content, focus, one native wrapper, editor empty guidance and visibility/motion repaired.

individual_findings: Individually reviewed all 97 controls and the actual preset, including all eight native date/icon/image/richtext/action slots. Removed timeline setup/example story from new insertion; existing merchant steps remain preserved. Blank configured slots no longer create phantom cards or markers; complete action-only entries work. Native ordered-list semantics retain actual chronological source order, sparse entries and native image alt. Escaped plain icons and URL attributes, complete actions and intact rich text. Logical inline geometry supports RTL; narrow containers become vertical with bounded marker offsets, and minimal markers are in flow rather than overlapping cards. Bounded widths/padding, one native wrapper and useful editor empty/visibility/motion behavior repaired.
